import polars as pl


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return raw.select(
        account=pl.lit("38-9000-7654321-01"),
        txn_date=pl.col("Posted Date").str.to_date("%Y-%m-%d", strict=False),
        description=pl.col("Particulars"),
        amount=pl.col("Amount")
        .str.to_decimal(strict=False)
        .cast(pl.Float64)
        .round(2),
        balance=pl.col("Balance")
        .str.to_decimal(strict=False)
        .cast(pl.Float64)
        .round(2),
        reference=pl.col("Txn ID"),
    )
